pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark-brown polygonal regions characterized by high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients against the inter-patch spaces. The spatial area of individual patches is significantly larger than the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow, light-cream pathways. Junction nodes are clearly defined, predominantly exhibiting tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections with sharp vertices.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small bird (oxpecker) perched on the right lateral side of the mid-neck region.
